answer: Suppose n Sybils need collateral C(n)=k n^2 and quadratic slashing S(n)=m n^2. Extracted value V is at most r n, linear in nodes. Marginal capital dC/dn=2kn and expected slashing dS/dn=2mn, so if k+m exceeds r/2, each extra Sybil costs more than added value. This pearl of cost asymmetry makes attacks across any meadow unprofitable; falcon slashing enforces the threshold.
